assumptions: load: IT × 0.6 (load_factor) × PUE 1.4–1.55; low pairs PUE 1.4 with low coefficients, high pairs 1.55 with high
generator capacity (size stage) taken as facility peak kW: a lower bound
cooling type unknown: evaporation / make-up / WUE are evaporative upper bounds; heat capture uses the liquid (cold-plate) run
COP for downstream parts: register tool range 3.0–4.5 (lot COP needs receiver_temp)

register_notes.note: Capture shares (LBNL 48–75 %, 0.5–0.8 band) are shares of SERVER heat, but the formula multiplies heat_rejected (facility energy incl. PUE overhead). E_reuse is overstated by the PUE factor (1.4–1.55): compare hc_hi with the "IT heat only" cross-check row.
Because heat_captured = heat_rejected × liquid_capture and E_DC = heat_rejected, ERF equals liquid_capture (0.5–0.8) for every lot; the quantity carries no lot information.

"idle floor 36% of max" is credited to lbnl2024 (role verified), but the lbnl2024 register text has no 36 % figure (it gives a 50 % capacity utilisation); lbnlCapture mentions 35 % capture at idle — a different quantity.
0.5–0.8 cold-plate band and immersion 1.0 have no primary (role says so); no air-cooled share → air run not computable.
Lot COP needs receiver_temp (not lot data). Lorenz formula reproduces the register Odense check (η 0.50 → 4.56). Downstream uses the register "tool range 3.0–4.5".

pv_roof coef P-16 quotes Vancouver 892–1,006 (vertical 718) and Edmonton 947–1,243 (vertical 990); the same coef, pv_facade (716 / 989), nrcanPVmunic and data/nrcan_pv_annual.json give 1,007 / 716 and 944 / 1,244 / 989. P-16 values match no source in the register.
sources = [ipcc2019v3ch7] but source_roles credits eccc (Climate Normals) with "all coefficients"; refrigerant and GWP not named; chiller count is size stage.

2.681 kg CO2/L is credited to eccc, whose register entry is the Climate Normals (no emission factor). Arithmetic is consistent: 0.263 L/kWh × 2.681 = 705 g/kWh vs AP-42 706. "Manor Farm 564 h/yr" has no source in the list and no per-unit / per-site basis.

NOx 0.024 lb/hp·h: eccc role relabelled "climate input only"; ap42_34 (the AP-42 source) is not in this part's list. Value equals 14.6 g/kWh (consistent with genset_test). No PM lb/hp·h factor; PM uses genset_test 0.43 g/kWh.

Generator capacity, unit count and redundancy are size stage; facility peak kW is used as a lower bound (capacity ≥ load). genset_test 14.5 h reconstructs from auc_27938 text: 26 × 15 min + 4 × 1 h at zero load + 2 × 2 h full load.
coef gives no value of C; femp text example 3→6 cycles used. femp "~20 % cut" checks (1 − 1.2/1.5 = 20 %). Evaporation is an upper bound (cooling type is size stage).

Factors −53 % blowdown / −16 % make-up are not consistent with the stated cycles 2.8 → 4.9 at constant evaporation (implies −54 % blowdown and −19 % make-up); applying 0.84 and 0.47 together over-determines the water balance. femp_ct covers blowdown reduction, not recovery (register open item). Skid count not stated.
At the evaporative upper bound WUE = 1.5 × PUE × C/(C−1) = 2.5–3.5 L/kWh for every lot, above the "DCRE cap 2 L/kWh" (DCRE not in the part's sources).

"BC as a range" gives no numbers (1.25–16.8 used); no Alberta value; femp role "all coefficients" but the femp text (BMP #10) has neither 1.25 nor 16.8. Input names it_load_actual; facility electricity used here.
NIR 2024 is flagged "a" (preliminary). Input names it_load_actual; facility electricity used (heat ≈ electricity). Alberta displacement factor is an offset-policy number, shown separately.
Formula says "T_outdoor < threshold"; the register's counts (7,109 / 7,614 at 18 °C; 3,284 / 5,522 at 8 °C; 7,675 / 7,846 dry cooler 30 °C) match ≤, not <. Both computed.

"one unit per MW" does not say MW of IT or of facility load: both used (low / high). r is lot edge to nearest residential parcel (input_check 8), so Lp is a closest-case screen; −8 is a hemispherical free-field simplification (iso9613 old: "our simplification").
Formula is floor-area based (size stage); per-MW route uses the Ark UP4 applicant figure (claim), which is not in the part's source list (jlarc2024, tourVAN3).
arden2021 register entry states no figures (check 2: unreachable) — the 0.75–1.28 kWh/m³ values cannot be checked against the register.
Allen 2011 119 W/m² is a peak grid cell (check 1), units assumed; comparison is indicative.
σy, σz coefficients and stack height H not given ("table to be checked against the final ISC3 edition"); downstream no2_at_receptor and heat_plume_dT (neighbour) therefore not computable.
Fossil diesel reference CI "to retrieve" — formula cannot be evaluated.
status says "Vancouver in hand (government export)", but gwells check 2 found no export files locally; Edmonton reports are indexed by ATS legal land description.
Named "condensate" but unit is hours; no litres-per-kW yield exists in the register (EPA office rule of thumb not for data halls).
"2N holds half" — 2N is not defined in the uptimeTiers text (role note).
4,177 kg is full life cycle including US use phase (claim); 10–15 % manufacturing share marked "?".
Lot area used as non-landscaped area (upper bound, per register); Vancouver full engineered volume not computed; all lots between 0.16 and 3.0 ha.
hp_electricity coef "allocation rule stated; show two rules" — the two rules are not stated.
